item.title: Welcome to my website!
item.description:
Hi! My name is Jiasen Liu; starting this October, I’ll be a Part III (MASt in Pure Mathematics) student at the University of Cambridge. I recently graduated from the University of Southern California with a B.S. in Mathematics and a minor in Computer Science.

I’m interested in homotopy theory and its connetions to algebraic/arithmetic geometry and representation theory. I also have a side interest in theoretical computer science, particularly voting theory and computational social choice.
